Item 5.02 Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Appointment of Officers.

On October 6, 2026, the board appointed Stephen Cumming as Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, effective immediately. He succeeded an interim CFO and became the principal financial and accounting officer. The appointment is a dated governance development, not proof of future cash flow.
